name: Steam
notes: Windows Steam client, one per bottle. Install with `SteamSetup.exe /S`, then run C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\Steam.exe. -cef-disable-gpu is required on the wrapped arm64 runtime (wine 11.19): without it the window rendered at first, then went blank after switching between Library, Store and Community. With it, page switching worked in a manual test. Verified (runtime 0.1.0): silent install, bootstrap, login, page switching, and installing and launching one game (There Are No Orcs) through Steam. Not verified: Steam Guard, Cloud saves, achievements, long sessions. On runtime 0.2.0 (arm64-11.20-5) Steam also ran with an existing prefix; the window stays black for a short time at startup before it loads (seen by eye). Steam's own logged startup time on warm starts is about the same on both runtimes: 7.6 to 8.7 s on 0.1.0 and 7.3 to 8.0 s on 0.2.0 (first starts, which include the client update, took 35.7 s and 69.3 s, but depend on the network). Verified on 0.2.0 with a fresh bottle: install, login, game install and launch; one cold relaunch timed out once for an unknown reason and worked in five later tries.
